Class RemoteClientView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am32.network.server.RemoteClientView
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameView, LobbyView, VirtualView, NetworkNode
public class RemoteClientView extends Object implements VirtualView, NetworkNode
A virtual view adapter between the controller and the network are represented.
